show.description:
She thought he was just another smooth-talking nobody living off her success - a man the world mocked as a gigolo. But when fate pulls them closer, she discovers he’s far from ordinary. Behind his mysterious charm lies the power, wealth, and immortality of a true billionaire - one who hides among humans.

In a world where love tests destiny and secrets outlive lifetimes, she must decide…
Can you trust the man everyone doubts - even if he’s not entirely human?
